core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rahman is an Arabic-origin name meaning “The Most Merciful”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rahman corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَان (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْمَان (Raḥmān)). Its core sense is rahman; the most merciful. Rahman is Arabic رَحْمَان (Raḥmān) 'the Most Merciful', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave رحمن (a non-standard form). The source gloss 'Compassionate, Merciful' is consistent.

etymology.etymology_explanation: The form رَحْمَان is an established Arabic lexical item, and Rahman is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

persian.name: رحمان
persian.long_meaning: Rahman (رحمان) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رحمان، بخشنده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

faq.q: What is the origin of Rahman?

faq.q: What is the root of Rahman?
faq.a: It is built on the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m).

Rahman is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Rahman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written رحمان and carries the sense “رحمان، بے حد مہربان”.

faq.q: Is Rahman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Rahman as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
